description:
One task entering a Board lane; the `board:lanes` entry's fields. It never carries a title, a description, a
holder or any session detail.

task.description: The task key that changed lane.
task.title: Task

lane.description: The id of the Board machine state the task entered.
lane.title: Lane

time.description: When the task entered the lane, in epoch seconds.
time.title: Time

team.description: The task's team key; empty on an entry replayed from the history or recorded when a write moved the task.
team.title: Team

milestone.description: The task's milestone; empty when it has none.
milestone.title: Milestone

labels.description: The task's labels; empty when it has none.
labels.title: Labels

profile.description: Which agent profile or model the task was routed to; empty when unrouted, and a person's name.
profile.title: Profile

assignee.description: The legacy name of `profile`, read on an entry an older instance wrote.
assignee.title: Assignee

actor.description: Who made the move: the actor of the write the board's server recorded it from (`operator`, `agent`, `anonymous`, `<instance>/<workflow>` or `starpulse/task-actor`), or `external` for a change no such write made (a hand edit of the board, a board adapter that records at placement); empty on an entry that predates actors.
actor.title: Actor

session.description: The harness session that made the move, as its write named it; empty when it named none.
session.title: Session

harness.description: The harness (`claude`, `cursor`) of that session; empty when the write named none.
harness.title: Harness

title: LaneEvent
